teamNews.text: Manchester City · Khusanov and Matheus Nunes are doubts. Rico Lewis could start at right-back.
Fulham · Emile Smith Rowe is ruled out. Tom Cairney is available again.
AFC Bournemouth · Junior Kroupi is available to start. Alex Scott is building up minutes.
Nottingham Forest · Callum Hudson-Odoi and Nicolás Domínguez are out.
Aston Villa · Matty Cash remains out. Aaron Wan-Bissaka is available and could return at right-back.
Sunderland · Brian Brobbey and Granit Xhaka are out after going off injured last match.
Chelsea · João Pedro and Reece James remain out. Moisés Caicedo is available again.
Coventry City · Haji Wright and Ephron Mason-Clark are expected to miss out. Bobby Thomas is doubtful.
Crystal Palace · Jean-Philippe Mateta is suspended. Ismaïla Sarr and Jørgen Strand Larsen are doubtful.
Tottenham Hotspur · Xavi Simons and Wilson Odobert remain out. James Maddison and Mathys Tel face fitness checks.
Newcastle United · Jacob Ramsey returns from suspension. Joelinton is expected to miss the match.
Arsenal · Martin Zubimendi and Bukayo Saka are out. Max Dowman is suspended.
Real Madrid · Rodrygo, Raúl Asencio and Ferland Mendy are out.
Celta Vigo · Borja Iglesias, Carl Starfelt and Ilaix Moriba are among Celta’s fitness doubts.
New England Revolution · Carles Gil created 97 chances over the regular season. Matt Turner played every regular-season minute.
1. FC Union Berlin · Unavailable: Juranović (ill), Markgraf (knee), Nsoki (calf), Skov (unconfirmed).
RB Leipzig · Unavailable: Gebel (knee), Guiu (hamstring), Ouédraogo (shoulder). Fitness doubts: Finkgräfe (hamstring).
Bayer Leverkusen · Unavailable: Eichhorn (match fitness), Kofane (thigh), Terrier (muscular), Tella (muscular).
SC Paderborn 07 · Unavailable: Awortwie-Grant (ankle), Gayret (knee), Hoffmeier (muscular).
Borussia Mönchengladbach · Unavailable: Bolin (muscular), Hashioka (muscular), Itakura (suspended), Kleindienst (muscular), Leopold (knee), Leszczyński (knee), Ullrich (collarbone).
Borussia Dortmund · Unavailable: Can (knee), Inácio (knee), Konstantelias (knee), Lerma (muscular). Fitness doubts: Chukwuemeka (muscular).
Eintracht Frankfurt · Unavailable: Baum (suspended), Ngankam (adductor). Fitness doubts: Uzun (ill).
TSG Hoffenheim · Unavailable: De Cat (knee), Gendrey (broken leg), Hajdari (foot), Hranáč (knee), Wimmer (hamstring).
SV Elversberg · Unavailable: Mickelson (knee), Pinckert (ankle), Seifert (ankle).
SC Freiburg · Unavailable: Muslija (knee), Yilmaz (suspended).
Schalke 04 · Unavailable: T. Becker (foot), Højlund (Achilles), Schallenberg (leg), Siebeking (abdominals), Vozar (hamstring), Wöber (hamstring).
VfB Stuttgart · Unavailable: Diehl (thigh), Jaquez (ribs), Malanga (abdominals), Stiller (adductor).
Como · Nico Paz is expected to play behind or alongside Tasos Douvikas.
Cagliari · Alieu Fadera and Mattia Felici are out. Yerry Mina, M’Bala Nzola and Harry Winks face fitness checks.
AS Roma · Dybala and Svilar are back. Rensch and Pellegrini are out.
Napoli · David Neres and Costantino Favasuli return from injury. Luca Marianucci has served his suspension.
Torino · Nikola Vlašić missed Croatia’s previous match with a thigh issue but is expected to feature.
Nice · Abdelmonem, Bombito, Abergel and A. Mendy are absent. Boudaoui and Abdi are doubtful.
Paris Saint-Germain · Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is absent.
AS Monaco · Idumbo, Golovin and Fati are out. Mawissa is a doubt.
AJ Auxerre · Akpa, Namaso and S. Fofana are among six absences. L. Dioubaté returns.
Lens · Bulatovic, Édouard and Nawrocki are out. Ivanovic returns.
Toulouse · Messali, Schmidt and Odogu are out. Donnum, A. Francis and Amougou return.
Lille · Igamane and T. Santos are out. Ueda returns.
Lyon · Mata, Openda, Morton, Sulc and Ouedraogo are out.
Strasbourg · Panichelli, Reyna and Oso are out. F. Baldé is a doubt.
Brest · Chardonnet and Le Guen are out. Sa. Diop is a doubt.
NEC Nijmegen · Emre Mor and Bram Nuytinck remain out.
PSV Eindhoven · Paul Wanner is nearing a return, though this match could come too early.
FC Utrecht · Victor Jensen and Kevin Paredes are out with knee injuries. Alonzo Engwanda remains sidelined.
Feyenoord Rotterdam · Hadj Moussa is a major doubt after spraining his ankle on international duty. Naoufal Sliti expects to play despite a hand injury.
Telstar · Gerald Alders is still recovering and will miss the match.
Celtic · The centre-forward spot is uncertain. Kasper Høgh has gone 16 appearances without scoring.
Aberdeen · Lewis Mayo, Chris Cadden, Kristers Towers, Emmanuel Gyamfi and Mats Knoester are out.
Motherwell · Lukas Fadinger is expected to captain the side from midfield.
Galatasaray · Davinson Sánchez withdrew from international duty with a muscle issue. Roland Sallai and Aleksey Batrakov are also unavailable.
